description: Recommend available volunteer tasks. Read only; never claims, joins a room, starts an agent or promises payment. Continue using nextCursor as after when hasMore.

after.description: Paging cursor: pass the previous response nextCursor when hasMore is true.

interests.description: Topics you want to work on, such as "accessibility" or "openapi" (up to 20). Ranked the same way as skills; nothing is filtered out.

limit.description: How many recommendations to return, 1-5. Default 3.

skills.description: Skills you can apply, as short words such as "typescript" or "docs" (up to 20). Tasks whose title or acceptance criteria contain one rank first; nothing is filtered out.

name: public_work_recommend
